description.value: Full-service private campground on the Alberni Inlet with beachfront and forested tent sites, a working marina, playground, and the Alberni Inlet Trail nearby; propane fires only (no wood), open April–September.

address.value: 2011 Franklin River Rd, Port Alberni, BC, V0R 2B0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a 250-site campground and marina on the Alberni Inlet, open April–October 2026. Showers ('paid showers' on campground and marina pages), laundry ('coin-operated laundry' confirmed on multiple pages and OSM laundry=yes), covered shelter ('Covered Picnic Shelter with fire pit'), reservations ('BOOK NOW' links to campspot.com), ice (marina amenities list), and propane camping fuel ('propane tanks available for purchase or exchange') are all explicitly stated on the website. No mention of dedicated hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, or e-bike charging. Contact details (phone, address) match between OSM and website.
concerns: Website uses '&' in name (China Creek Campground & Marina) while OSM uses 'and'; retained OSM spelling per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-equipped campground with tent sites, showers, laundry, and covered shelter that would serve touring cyclists on Vancouver Island well. Open for 2026 season with online booking available.

wow_evidence: paid showers, coin-operated laundry, covered picnic shelter; 250-site campground and marina on Alberni Inlet
